summary.name: DeskDay
summary.one_liner: DeskDay is an AI-native professional services automation (PSA) platform for managed service providers (MSPs) and internal IT teams, combining a conversational service desk, workflows, knowledge base, projects, billing and reporting.
use_cases: Raising and triaging IT support tickets
Running an MSP service desk for multiple clients
Automating routine ticket replies and dispatch
Connecting Claude or another MCP assistant to service desk data
Billing and reporting for managed IT services
summary.what_it_does: DeskDay provides a service desk where end users raise tickets by email or through IT-Connect, its end-user app, and chat with techs from Microsoft Teams, desktop, mobile and web. Ask Helena is a chat and voice assistant that answers questions about data and performs tasks such as creating tickets, building reports and replying to users. An AI copilot on each ticket pulls context, suggests fixes from knowledge bases and past tickets, reads sentiment and drafts replies. An MCP connector lets Claude and other MCP-compatible assistants read and write DeskDay data with per-action permissions, and a public API supports custom integrations. The page also lists integrations with RMM, accounting, payments and documentation tools such as NinjaOne, Datto, QuickBooks, Xero, Stripe and Hudu.
notable: Ask Helena AI assistant with typed or voice input
MCP connector for Claude and other MCP-compatible assistants
AI Triage & Dispatch agent live now
Claims of about two weeks to go live
caveats: Priced per technician; the page points to a pricing page for current plans, so exact costs are unknown
Claims such as 2x less time and 30% higher CSAT are vendor-reported figures
Only the Triage & Dispatch AI agent is stated as live; other agents are upcoming
